content: If you are in Canada and experience side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. Precautions: Before using atropine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to belladonna alkaloids (such as hyoscyamine or scopolamine), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. After applying this medication, your vision may become temporarily blurred. Additionally, this medication may increase your eyes' sensitivity to light, so protect your eyes in bright light. Infants and small children may be more susceptible to the side effects of this drug. Ensure that this medication does not enter a child’s mouth. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication can be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: If you are using this medication on a regular schedule and miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light. Do not freeze it. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current information.
